purpose: Create one stable synthetic narrator identity for direct ElevenLabs narration generation.

production.delivery: direct text-to-speech with inline performance directions

voiceDescription: Native American English. Male, 45–60. Excellent studio quality. Persona: a master fantasy audiobook storyteller performing an adventure for an intimate audience. A rich, low, resonant baritone with clear diction and natural authority. Highly expressive rather than restrained or monotone: varied pitch, rhythm, emphasis, and emotional color; able to move from ominous scene-setting into wonder, urgency, warmth, and distinct character delivery while remaining recognizably the same narrator. Dramatic and alive, never a movie-trailer announcer and never flat.
previewText: [Ominous, vivid narration] This was once the chapel of the keep. Inside the doorway are the dried husks of two orcs, their faces twisted with terror. A large altar dominates the southern wall. [With startled awe] The shape speaks. [As a weary, haunted spirit; deeper and more intimate] 'I am the life form of Ferran Martinez, bound with the undead spirits of all who die within these walls to guard the keep. Tell me, has the city been freed?'

fishAnchor.source: Generate a clean neutral anchor from the owner-approved saved ElevenLabs voice.
